en.headline: Food hygiene department reports officers to police over alleged fraudulent leave
en.dek: Several hawker control officers face investigation after they allegedly obtained temporary absence approvals for union activities but were filmed shopping and at a gym.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said on Saturday that several hawker control officers might have fraudulently obtained approval for temporary absence from duty, claiming they were participating in staff union affairs.

A department spokesman described the situation as completely unacceptable. Because criminal offences may be involved, the department has reported the case to the police and will cooperate with the investigation.

The department has also started its own disciplinary investigation and said it will take stern action against any officers found to have committed misconduct. False declarations or abusive acts will not be tolerated.

Government guidelines allow civil servants temporary absence during working hours for legitimate union activities, and the department generally approves such applications without intervening in union operations. Officers granted leave must still follow approval conditions and the integrity rules that apply to all civil servants.

In addition to the investigations, the department will review the mechanism for applying for and monitoring temporary absence for union affairs, aiming to prevent abuse while not hindering normal union activities. The action followed a local television programme that aired footage of officers allegedly grocery shopping and working out at a gym during shift hours.

zh.headline: 食環署向警方舉報小販管理隊人員涉詐騙請假
zh.dek: 數名小販管理隊人員疑以參與職工會事務為由申請暫時離職，但電視節目拍攝到他們購物及健身，署方已報警並展開紀律調查。
body: 食物環境衛生署周六表示，數名小販管理隊人員可能以參與職工會事務為藉口，欺詐取得暫時離職批准，情況完全不能接受。
署方發言人指，事件可能涉及刑事罪行，已向警方舉報，並會全力配合警方調查。
在不影響警方調查的前提下，署方已展開紀律調查，對證實有不當行為的人員會採取嚴厲紀律處分，絕不容忍任何虛假申報或濫權行為。
政府已訂立指引，容許公務員在工作時間內暫時離職參與合法職工會活動，署方一般會按指引批准有關申請，不會直接干預職工會內部運作。獲批人員必須遵守批准條件，以及所有公務員均須遵守的紀律和誠信要求。
除紀律調查外，署方會檢討現時人員申請及監察暫時離職處理職工會事務的機制，以防濫用，同時不影響正常職工會活動。事件源於本地電視節目播出有關人員在當值時間購物及到健身室的片段。
